{"sql":"WITH paid_social AS (
    SELECT
        months_since_activation,
        n_observable,
        avg_margin_eur,
        cac_eur,
        SUM(avg_margin_eur) OVER (
            ORDER BY months_since_activation
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS cumulative_margin_eur
    FROM agg_unit_economics
    WHERE channel = 'paid_social'
), summary AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(months_since_activation) AS latest_observed_month,
        MAX(cumulative_margin_eur) FILTER (
            WHERE months_since_activation = (SELECT MAX(months_since_activation) FROM paid_social)
        ) AS cumulative_margin_at_latest_month_eur,
        MAX(cac_eur) AS cac_eur,
        MIN(months_since_activation) FILTER (WHERE cumulative_margin_eur >= cac_eur) AS first_payback_month,
        MAX(n_observable) FILTER (
            WHERE months_since_activation = (SELECT MAX(months_since_activation) FROM paid_social)
        ) AS n_observable_at_latest_month
    FROM paid_social
)
SELECT
    latest_observed_month,
    cumulative_margin_at_latest_month_eur,
    cac_eur,
    cumulative_margin_at_latest_month_eur - cac_eur AS net_margin_after_cac_eur,
    first_payback_month,
    n_observable_at_latest_month,
    cumulative_margin_at_latest_month_eur >= cac_eur AS paid_back_by_latest_observed_month
FROM summary;","rationale":"Compare cumulative average contribution margin per activated paid-social user with channel CAC through the latest fully observed tenure; report whether and when the channel reaches payback."}
